getChapterList.description: 按文章分页生成虚拟章节

actions.code: (() => { const base = 'https://www.wai76.com'; const strip = (v) => { let s = String(v || '').trim(); while (s.indexOf('/') === 0) s = s.slice(1); return s; }; let raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (raw.indexOf('http://') === 0 || raw.indexOf('https://') === 0) return raw; return new URL(strip(raw), base + '/').href; })();

(() => { const strip = (v) => { let s = String(v || '').trim(); while (s.indexOf('/') === 0) s = s.slice(1); while (s.endsWith('/')) s = s.slice(0, -1); return s; }; const normalizeBase = (href) => { try { const u = new URL(href, location.href); const parts = u.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean); if (parts.length > 1 && /^\d+$/.test(parts[parts.length - 1])) parts.pop(); u.pathname = '/' + parts.join('/') + '/'; u.search = ''; u.hash = ''; return u.href; } catch (e) { return href; } }; const makeId = (href) => { try { const u = new URL(href, location.href); return strip(u.pathname + u.search); } catch (e) { return strip(href); } }; const baseUrl = normalizeBase(location.href); const map = {}; map[1] = baseUrl; document.querySelectorAll('a.post-page-numbers[href]').forEach((a) => { const n = parseInt(String(a.textContent || '').trim(), 10); const href = a.getAttribute('href') || ''; if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 1 && href) map[n] = new URL(href, location.href).href; }); const nums = Object.keys(map).map((k) => parseInt(k, 10)).filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n)).sort((a, b) => a - b); const out = nums.map((n) => { const url = map[n]; return { id: makeId(url), title: '第' + n + '组', url, number: n, date: '', publishTime: '' }; }); return JSON.stringify(out.length > 0 ? out : [{ id: makeId(baseUrl), title: '第1组', url: baseUrl, number: 1, date: '', publishTime: '' }]); })();

getPageList.description: 获取当前分页内原图列表

actions.code: (() => { const base = 'https://www.wai76.com'; const strip = (v) => { let s = String(v || '').trim(); while (s.indexOf('/') === 0) s = s.slice(1); return s; }; let raw = String('{{chapterId}}' || '').trim(); if (raw.indexOf('http://') === 0 || raw.indexOf('https://') === 0) return raw; return new URL(strip(raw), base + '/').href; })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.wai76.com'; const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(String(v || '').replace(/&/g, '&'), location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return String(v || ''); } }; const pages = []; const seen = {}; const headers = [{ name: 'Referer', value: location.href }, { name: 'Origin', value: base }]; document.querySelectorAll('.entry-content .spotlight[data-src], .spotlight[data-src]').forEach((el) => { const url = abs(el.getAttribute('data-src') || ''); if (!url || seen[url] || url.indexOf('/gallery/') < 0) return; seen[url] = true; pages.push({ index: pages.length, page: pages.length, url, imageUrl: url, requestHeaders: headers }); }); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
